decisions.reason: Because A has remained on the website across two years, management is likely to justify the resources already invested and keep it on the market, despite only moderate public visibility.

C had a clearly public premium launch and is still mentioned in 2024, so even with reduced prominence management is likely to persist a bit longer and attribute any disappointment to a slow build-up rather than abandon it now.
D is a very recent 2024 launch presented on its own page and explicitly framed as part of the Bio line, which makes management more likely to continue it to defend the announced direction.
E received a visible 2024 launch with multiple variants in the organic range, so the firm is likely to stay committed and give the product more time before considering withdrawal.
F is also a fresh 2024 launch with its own page, and the combination of recent investment and public commitment makes a near-term withdrawal unlikely.
